content: Bɔhɔ Yesu Fɛ́ Owíe Yerusalem
Brɛ́á Yesu mʋa mʋ akasɩ́pʋ́ bɛbɛ́ɛn Yerusalem wúlu, bɛta Betfage wúlu ánɩ́ ɩbʋ Nfɔ-nyíbʋ

ámʋ asɩ wie tá á, ɔlɔwa mʋ akasɩ́pʋ́ abanyɔ́ gyankpá. Ɔlɛbláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mlɩyɔ wúlu anfɩ́ ɩda mlɩ ansɩ́tɔ́ ánfɩsʋ. Nɩ́ mlowíé wúlu amʋ ɔnɔ́ á, mlówun afrímú tsɩ́hɛ́ ɔkʋá ɔda ɔfɛ́tɔ́, mʋ bi lɩ́ɩ́ mʋ wá. Mlɩsankɩ mʋ, amlɩkpa amʋ́ ba mɩ.
Nɩ́ ɔkʋ ɔfɩ́tɛ́ mlɩ asʋankʋ á, mlɩbla mʋ mlɩaa, ‘Anɩ Wíe dɛ́ amʋ́ hián.’ Ɩnʋnʋ ɔbɛ́ha mlɔ́pʋ amʋ́ ba mɩ.”
Ɩ́nɩ lɛ́ha Bulu asʋ́n ámʋ́ʋ́ ɔlɛblɩ́ tsʋn mʋ ɔnɔ́sʋ́ ɔtɔɩ́pʋ́sʋ ámʋ lɛ́ba mʋ́tɔ́. Ɔbɛ́ɛ,

content.text: Mlɩkɩ, mlɩ Wíe ɔbá mlɩ wá.

content: Yesu akasɩ́pʋ́ abanyɔ́ ámʋ bɔyɔ́bwɛ alɩ ámʋ́ʋ́ Yesu lɛ́bláa amʋ́ ámʋ.
Bɛkpa afrímú mʋa mʋ bi ámʋ ba, bɛyaɩ́ amʋ́ atati dɩ́nká amʋ́sʋ́, ɔlɔdʋ bian mʋsʋ.
Ɔdɔm kpɔnkpɔɔnkpɔntɩ bɛyaɩ́ amʋ́ atati tswɩ ɔkpatɔ, akʋ ɛ́ bebiabía afɩtáa bunbun ɔkpa ámʋtɔ.
Ɔdɔm amʋ́ʋ́ bʋgya Yesu nkpá mʋ́a ɔma amʋ bɔsʋrá okitikíti bɛɛ, “Hosiána há Dawid mʋ na ámʋ! Bulu oyúla owíe anfɩ ɔbá mʋ dátɔ́ ánfɩ! Hosiána bʋ ɔsʋ́sʋ́ʋ́sʋ́!”
Brɛ́á Yesu lówie Yerusalem a, wúlu amʋtɔ fɛ́ɛ́ lɛda kpokiti, bʋdɛfɩtɛ́ bɛɛ, “Ma gyí ɔhá ánfɩ?”
Ɔdɔm amʋ́ʋ́ bʋbuo mʋ amʋ bɛlɛ mʋ́ ɔnɔ́ bɛɛ, “Ɔ́nɩ gyí Yesu, Bulu ɔnɔ́sʋ́ ɔtɔɩ́pʋ́ amʋ́ʋ́ otsú Nasaret wúluá ɩbʋ Galilea ɔmátɔ́ ámʋ nɩ.”
Yesu Bulu Ɔtswɛ́kpa Yɔ
Mʋ́ʋ́ Yesu lɔ́yɔ Bulu ɔtswɛ́kpa wunsɩnɛ́sʋ́ ɩnʋ, yégya atɔ́ afɛpʋ́ pʋ́ atɔ́ ahɔ́pʋ fɛ́ɛ́ dalɩ. Olowuwúta kɔ́ba atsɛ́pʋ mpʋ́nʋ́ dá, súnsúnki abrɔ́dʋma afɛpʋ́ ɛ́ mbíá dá.
Ɔlɛbláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Bɔwanlɩ́n wá Bulu asʋ́n ámʋtɔ bɛɛ, ‘Bɛ́tɩ mɩ́ ɔtswɛ́kpa bɛɛ, mpáɩ ɔbɔkpá.’ Támɛ mlɩlapʋ́ ɩnʋ mlí awikplu ɔŋaínkpá.”
Ansibi abwiepʋ́ pʋ́ abubúpʋ akʋ bɛba mʋ wá Bulu ɔtswɛ́kpa wunsɩnɛ́sʋ́ ɩnʋ, ɔlɛtsa amʋ́ ɩlɔ.

Brɛ́á Bulu igyí ahapʋ́ dɛhɛn pʋ́ Mose mbla asunápʋ́ amʋ bowun ofúla ánɩ́ Yesu dɛ́bwɛ, pʋ́ alɩá nyebí bʋdɛkplʋ́n Bulu ɔtswɛ́kpa wunsɩnɛ́sʋ́ ɩnʋ bɛɛ, “Hosiána há Dawid mʋ na ámʋ!” a, ɔblɔ́ lɛkɩtá amʋ́.

Mʋ́ sʋ bɛfɩtɛ́ Yesu bɛɛ, “Fʋmedénu asʋ́n ánɩ́ nyebí ánfɩ bʋdɛblɩ́?” Yesu lɛ́lɛ mʋ́ ɔnɔ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ndenu. Mlɩmɔ́kʋ́kla asʋ́n ánɩ́ Bulu asʋ́n wanlɩ́nhɛ́ amʋ lɛ́blɩ́? Ɔbɛ́ɛ, ‘Fasúná nyebí pʋ́ amʋ́á bʋmɔkʋ́tɩn nyɔ́pʋ alɩá bʋkánfʋ fʋ́.’ ”
Yesu lɛ́dalɩ wúlu amʋtɔ sí amʋ́ yɔ́ Betania. Ɩnʋ́ ɔlɛdɩ ɛkɛ ámʋ nɩ.
Pɔntɔ Oyí Lwɩɩ́
Ɔyɩ kɛhɛ nyankɩ, brɛ́á Yesu léyinkí ɔbá Yerusalem a, akʋ́n dɛ mʋ.

Mʋ́ sʋ brɛ́á olowun pɔntɔ kʋá ɩlɩɩ́ mantáa ɔkpa á, ɔlɛbaɩ́ yɔ́ mʋ́ asɩ. Ɔlɔyɔ á, omowun abí kʋkʋ mʋ́tɔ́, afɩtáa sɔ́ɔ́n bʋ mʋ́sʋ́. Ɩnʋ ɔlɛbláa pɔntɔ ámʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Tsú ndɛ fʋmɛ́ɛtrá swie abí ɛkɛkɛɛkɛ!” Ɩnʋnʋ oyí ámʋ lówu.
Mʋ akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ bowun alɩá oyí ámʋ labwɛ́ á, ɔnɔ́ lobwie amʋ́. Mʋ́ sʋ bɛfɩtɛ́ bɛɛ “Ntogyi sʋ́ oyí ánfɩ lawú ɔtsáwʋlɛ pɛ́ alɩ?”

Yesu lɛ́bláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ɔnɔkwalɩ ndɛ mlɩ bláa. Nɩ́ mlɔhɔ Bulu gyi, mlɩmégyi nwɛ́ɛn a, mlɛ́talɩ́ bwɛ́ ɩtɔ́ ánfɩ nabwɛ́ oyí ánfɩ pʋ́ mʋ́á ɩdʋn mʋ́. Mlɛ́talɩ́ bláa ɩbʋ ánfɩ mlɩaa, ‘Puli yowie ɔpʋtɔ.’ Ibópulí yɔ́.
Nɩ́ mlɔhɔ Bulu gyi, mlɔkʋ́lɩ́ mʋ tógyítɔ́ á, mlɩ ɩbɩ bɛ́da mʋ́.”
Yesu Túmi Ɩwɩ Asʋn Fɩtɛ́hɛ́

Yesu léyinkí bowie Bulu ɔtswɛ́kpa wunsɩnɛ́sʋ́ ɩnʋ. Brɛ́á ɔdɛ atɔ́ suná á, Bulu igyi ahapʋ́ dɛhɛn pʋ́ Yudafɔ ahandɛ amʋ bɛba mʋ wá. Bɛfɩtɛ́ mʋ bɛɛ, “Ma lɛ́ha fʋ́ ɔkpa, fʋ́dɛ ntobí ánfɩ bwɛ? Ma lɛ́ha fʋ́ túmi?”
Yesu lɛ́lɛ mʋ́ ɔnɔ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mɩ́ ɛ́ nfɩ́tɛ mlɩ asʋn kua kʋlɛ. Nɩ́ mlɛlɛ́ mʋ́ ɔnɔ́ á, nɛ́bláa mlɩ túmi oduá ndɛpʋbwɛ́ ntobí ánfɩ.

Bulu wá Asú Ɔbɔpʋ́ Yohane lénya túmi pʋ́bɔ́ ahá asú, ntɛ́ɛ nyankpʋsa?” Amʋ́ wʋlɛwʋlɛ bɔyɔ asʋ́n ánfɩtɔ bɛɛ, “Nɩ́ ablɩ́ anɩaa itsú Bulu wá á, ɔbɛ́fɩtɛ́ anɩ ɔbɛ́ɛ, mʋ́ ntogyi sʋ́ anɩmɔ́hɔ mʋ gyi?
Ntɛ́ɛ ablɩ́ɩ anɩaa, anyánkpʋ́sa wá itsú.” Támɛ bʋdɛ tɔ́á ahá tsɔtsɔɔtsɔ ámʋ bɔ́bwɛ amʋ́ ifú nya. Tsúfɛ́ amʋ́ fɛ́ɛ́ bohogyi ánɩ́ Bulu ɔnɔ́sʋ́ ɔtɔɩ́pʋ́ Yohane gyí.
Mʋ́ sʋ bɛlɛ mʋ́ ɔnɔ́ bɛɛ, “Ohwée! Anɩméyín ɔtɩ́nɛ́á olenya mʋ túmi tsú.” Mʋ́ʋ́ Yesu ɛ́ lɛ́bláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mʋ́mʋ́ mɩ́ ɛ́ mmɛ́ɛbláa mlɩ túmi oduá ndɛpʋbwɛ́ ntobí ánfɩ.”
Oyin Ɔkʋ Abi Anyɔ Ɩwɩ Yébi
“Mlɩyɔ asʋ́n ánfɩtɔ amlɩkɩ. Oyin ɔkʋ mʋa mʋ abi anyɔ betsiá. Ɛkɛ ɔkʋ ɔlɔyɔ yɛ́bláa ɔdɛ́hɛn ɔbɛ́ɛ, ‘Mɩ́ bí, ndɛ yɔyɔ agyʋ́má mɩ́ ndɔtɔ ha mɩ.’
Ɔlɛbláa mʋ sɩ ɔbɛ́ɛ, ‘Mmɔ́ɔyɔ.’ Mʋ́ ɔma a, ɔlɛlatsɛ mʋ agywɩɩn, yɔ́ ndɔ ámʋtɔ.
Amʋ́ sɩ́ lɛ́natɩ́ yɔ́ ɔkʋsʋ amʋ ɛ́ wá yɛ́bláa mʋ alɩ kɛ́n. Ɔkʋsʋ amʋ lótsulá ɔbɛ́ɛ, ‘Mɩ́ sɩ́, nɔ́yɔ.’ Támɛ ɔmɔyɔ.”

Ɩnʋ Yesu lɛ́fɩtɛ́ ahá ámʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Abi anyɔ ámʋtɔ ɔmɔmʋ lɔ́bwɛ dɩ́nká mʋ sɩ asʋ́nsʋ́?” Yudafɔ igyí ahapʋ́ dɛhɛn pʋ́ Yudafɔ ahandɛ amʋ bɛbláa mʋ bɛɛ, “Ɔdɛ́hɛn amʋ.” Mʋ́ʋ́ Yesu lɛ́bláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ɔnɔkwalɩ ndɛ mlɩ bláa. Lampóo ahɔ́pʋ pʋ́ obu-ɔnɔ́ atsiápʋ́ bówie Bulu iwíegyí ámʋtɔ sí mlɩ.

Tsúfɛ́ Asú Ɔbɔpʋ́ Yohane lóbosuná mlɩ tsiátɔ́ oduá ɩda ɔkpa Bulu ansɩ́tɔ́, támɛ mlɩmɔ́hɔ mʋ gyi. Lampóo ahɔ́pʋ pʋ́ obu-ɔnɔ́ atsiápʋ́ bɔhɔ mʋ gyi. Ɔma mlɩlówun ánɩ́ amʋ́ kʋ́ráá batsɛ a, mlɩmɛ́tsɛ mlɩ agywɩɩn hɔ mʋ gyi.
Apafɔ Laláhɛ Akʋ

“Mlɩnu yébi ɩkʋ ɛ́. Ɔdɔtɔpʋ ɔkʋ lɔ́dɔ wáɩn ndɔ. Olegyi ɩban bómlí mʋ́. Olokwi wáɩn amʋ onyimɛ́kpá. Ɔlɔpwɛ obu fʋ́áhɛ́ kʋ há ndɔ ámʋ agyópʋ. Mʋ́ʋ́ ɔlɔpʋ ndɔ ámʋ wá apafɔ ɩbɩtɔ, olotu ɔkpa yɔ́ ɔmá ɩkʋtɔ.
Brɛ́á wáɩn-abí amʋ kpɔtɩ́bɩ lɔ́fʋn a, ɔlɔwa mʋ asúmpʋ́ apafɔ ámʋ wá ɔbɛ́ɛ, bʋyɔ́hɔ mʋ ogyíkpá ba mʋ.
Támɛ apafɔ ámʋ bɛkɩtá amʋ́, dá ɔkʋlɛ, mɔ́ ɔkʋlɛ, dá ɔkʋlɛ ɛ́ abwi.
Ndɔ mʋ wie amʋ lɛ́trá wa mʋ asúmpʋ́ bámbá ánɩ́ bʋtsɔ dʋn agyankpapʋ amʋ. Apafɔ ámʋ bɔbwɛ amʋ́ ɛ́ alɩ kɛ́n.
Mʋ́ tráhɛ kʋ́ráá á, ɔlɛblɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, ‘Oo, bóbu mɩ́ bí kwɩ́ɩ́hɛ́ mʋ́.’ Mʋ́ sʋ ɔlɔwa mʋ ɛ́.
Támɛ brɛ́á apafɔ ámʋ bowun mʋ bi ámʋ sɩ́sɩ́ á, bɛbláa aba bɛɛ, ‘Ɔ́nɩ obégyi mʋ sɩ atɔ́ nɩ́. Mlɩha amɔ mʋ, mɛ́nɩ ndɔ ámʋ ibémlí anɩ klɛ́.’
Mʋ́ sʋ bɛkɩtá mʋ, bɩ́tɩ́a mʋ dálɩ ndɔ ámʋtɔ yɔ́mɔ mʋ.”
“Nɩ́ ndɔ mʋ wie ɔbá á, ntɔ mlɩlahogyi mlɩaa, ɔbɔ́bwɛ apafɔ ánfɩ?”

Yudafɔ igyi ahapʋ́ dɛhɛn pʋ́ Yudafɔ ahandɛ amʋ bɛlɛ mʋ́ ɔnɔ́ bɛɛ, “Ɔbɛ́ha aha laláhɛ anfɩ bówu lowu sɩ́nsɩ́n, ɔbɛ́lapʋ́ ndɔ ámʋ wá apafɔ bámbá ɩbɩtɔ. Amʋ́á bétsiá pʋ́ mʋ atɔ́-abí ba mʋ mʋ́ kpɔtɩ́bɩ.”
Mʋ́ʋ́ Yesu lɛ́fɩtɛ́ amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ntɛ́ɛ mlɩmɔ́kʋ́kla Bulu asʋn wanlɩ́nhɛ́ amʋ kɩ? Bɔwanlɩ́n bɛɛ,
“Mʋ́ sʋ ndɛ mlɩ bláa mbɛ́ɛ, Bulu ɔbɔ́hɔ mʋ iwíegyí ámʋ lɛ́ mlɩ ɩbɩtɔ pʋ́há ɔmá ánɩ́ bɔbwɛ tɔ́á otekle.
“Ɩ́nɩ sʋ ɔhá ánɩ́ ɔlɛdɩda ibwi ámʋsʋ obébiabía blúblúblúblú. Nɩ́ ibwi ámʋ isúnkí dá ɔkʋsʋ ɛ́ á, ɩbɔ́kwɛ mʋ fɩ́kɔ́fɩ́kɔ́fɩ́kɔ́ fɛ́ nfúó.
Brɛ́á Bulu igyi ahapʋ́ dɛhɛn pʋ́ Farisifɔ ámʋ bonu Yesu ayébi anfɩ á, ɩlɔwankɩ́ amʋ́ ánɩ́ amʋ́ ɔdɛ.
Tɛkɩ bekleá bɛ́kɩtá mʋ, támɛ benya ifú, tsúfɛ́ ɔdɔm amʋ bʋtobú Yesu ánɩ́ Bulu ɔnɔ́sʋ́ ɔtɔɩ́pʋ́ ogyi.

footnotes.text: -2 Nfɔ-nyíbʋ igyi obubwí kʋá ɩbʋ mantáa Yerusalem, bʋtɛtɩ́ mʋ́ Olifbʋ.
Mʋ́tɔ́ yée 44 ɩma nwʋlʋ́ dada amʋ akʋtɔ.
